stories.story: Lily wanted to fly a kite, but the kite was torn. Lily said, “I want to repair the kite.” Dad said, “The boat needs a sail.” Lily said, “I can cover the tear.” Lily covered the tear with the tape. Lily launched the kite in the wind. Lily and Dad watched the patched kite. The kite danced above the meadow.

Sam wanted to fly a kite, but the kite was torn. Sam said, “I want to repair the kite.” Mum said, “The boat needs a sail.” Sam said, “I want to make a sail.” Mum cut a small sail from the kite with the scissors. Sam tied the sail to the boat with the string. Sam set the boat on the pond. Sam and Mum watched the boat. The boat sailed across the pond.
